name: Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm
label: Quest
description: In Thunder Bluff, Orm Stonehoof has the skill to forge the Brutal Helm. Thun'grim Firegaze sends warriors to him for that work.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Thunder Bluff, Orm Stonehoof has the skill to forge the Brutal Helm. Thun'grim Firegaze sends warriors to him for that work.

Warriors who prove their mettle and assemble pieces of the Brutal Armor in the Barrens are sent up to Thunder Bluff. Thun'grim Firegaze is an accomplished armorsmith, but he knows the work has reached beyond his own skill. He refers the warriors to Orm Stonehoof, whose craft is renowned across Kalimdor. Orm can shape resilient battlefield helms from rare, savage trophies.

Orm Stonehoof lives and works on the high bluffs of Mulgore, near the tranquil pool beneath Thunder Bluff's towering central totem. When a warrior arrives with Thun'grim Firegaze's word, Orm leaves his routine work to discuss the demanding components needed for a helm worthy of the Horde's front lines.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orm Stonehoof is respected greatly for his skill. He will make for you the brutal helm.
Seek him out in Thunder Bluff, near the pool by the city's great, central totem.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, adventurer. I am Orm, and Thun'grim tells me you wish a helm made?
